info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking It Management System Development By System Development Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API endpoint provides detailed information about a specific Banking IT Management System Development based on its unique identifier. Developers can retrieve vital data related to the system development process, including configuration, status, and related metrics. Typical consumers of this API include project managers and IT professionals involved in the banking sector, who require insight into development projects for analysis and oversight. The endpoint enhances transparency and aids in decision-making processes regarding ongoing or completed system developments.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of a specific system development resource identified by RES-100045. It provides relevant information necessary for managing system development activities effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve details for the specified system development resource (RES-100045). The request should contain all necessary parameters in the JSON format to ensure accurate data retrieval.

environment.description: The environment in which the system is deployed (e.g., production, staging).

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for the system.

plannedAt.description: The planned date and time for the system operation.

serviceTier.description: The service tier of the system (e.g., basic, premium).

version.description: The version number of the system.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a bearer token for authentication. The token must be provided in the Authorization header as 'Bearer {token}'. The token is expected to be a JSON Web Token (JWT) that is used to verify the identity of the user and provide access to secure resources.
